leakage_statement: All features end at D-3; thresholds train-frozen; test issues >= 2020-01-01; no future or live-only inputs.
fit: seasonal table: TRAIN daily 2010-2019 per (block,issue-DOY), Laplace+0.5; PERSIST LR: fixed C=1.0 lbfgs on [log1p(f7),log1p(f14)] ending D-3, TRAIN JJAS daily pooled, per window; no tuning on 2020-2025
test: weekly JJAS/FULLYR 2020-2025, last issue 2025-12-01; W3=D+17..23, W4=D+24..30; labels BELOW x<=t33, ABOVE x>t66 else NEAR
excluded: MJO, ENSO, IOD, SoilGrids, GEFS, ECMWF/Open-Meteo, live-only data
